title: tsaTwinBed operation
description: Temperature-swing adsorption twin-bed pair, cycle-averaged: one column adsorbs at T_ads while its twin regenerates at T_regen, swapping every half-cycle, and the reported streams are the CYCLE AVERAGES. The working capacity is the isotherm difference between the two temperatures — a capacity the isotherm cannot deliver at the declared pair REFUSES rather than quietly under-delivering (the tsa02 teaching case exists to fire that refusal).

adsorbent.title: Adsorbent
adsorbent.description: Resolved by name in the assets catalogue; brings the isotherms whose T-swing is the separation.

tCycle.title: Cycle time
tCycle.description: Full cycle period; each bed spends half adsorbing, half regenerating.

lightKey.title: Light key
lightKey.description: The weakly-adsorbed component that leaves as the product.
